item.title: Beijing Xiangshan Family Hotel — 2-Night All-Inclusive Package ¥1,098 (≈$155), was ¥3,936
item.description:
Deal price: family play package, 1 night — ¥599 (≈$85) (was ¥1,896, 32% of list) · All-inclusive, 2 nights — ¥1,098 (≈$155) (was ¥3,936) · Valid Aug 20 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

Right by Xiangshan (Fragrant Hills) in Haidian, this is the autumn trip Beijing families book: the red-foliage season comes with zero weekend surcharge, and the 2-night all-inclusive package covers a Hollywood-themed family room, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child each night, unlimited water-park play (09:00–21:00), a light meal for two, 3 tickets to the National Botanical Garden (~10 min drive), and the on-site petting park.

item.title: Gubei Water Town Inn Stay from ¥439 (≈$62) — 1 Night + Scenic Tickets + Hot-Spring Baths + Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: inn room, 1 night — ¥439 (≈$62) (was ¥529) · Family room inn, 1 night — ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥948) · Valid Sep 11, 2026 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

A night inside Gubei Water Town, the canal-laced old-town replica at the foot of the Simatai Great Wall in Miyun, Beijing. The inn package bundles one night with scenic-area tickets (multiple entries during your stay), unlimited rides on the in-town shuttle, access to the hot-spring bathhouses open in the scenic area, and breakfast — a genuinely good all-in-one deal for a water-town getaway.

item.title: Hangzhou Xianghu Kaiyuan Grand Hotel + Theme-Park Bundles from ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night superior room + breakfast + kayak/Xianghu cruise for 2 — ¥499 (≈$70) · 2 nights deluxe terrace room + breakfast + dining credit — ¥888 (≈$125) (was ¥2,188, 41% of list) · Valid Sep 11 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

Inside Xianghu National Tourist Resort in Xiaoshan, the Kaiyuan Grand sells mix-and-match bundles: a lakeside night plus your pick of kayaking, a Xianghu cruise, Senbo Water Park / Fantasy Island tickets, or Changqiao Polar Ocean Park + kids’ park tickets — with a free 2-hour hanfu experience, a kids’ DIY craft session, welcome fruit, heated pool, gym and parking thrown in.

item.title: Jing-Jin-Ji Attraction Annual Pass from ¥42.5 (≈$6) — 150+ Beijing, Tianjin & Hebei Sights
item.description:
Deal price: annual pass (standard), 1 card — ¥42.5 (≈$6) · 2 cards — ¥85 (≈$12) · Premium pass — ¥95 (≈$13) · Supreme pass — ¥189 (≈$27) (was ¥298, 63% off) · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime

The 2027 Jing-Jin-Ji tourist annual pass (electronic version) unlocks 150–170+ attractions across Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei: Beijing Aquarium (with zoo access), Beijing Wildlife Park, Phoenix Ridge （凤凰岭）, Juyongguan Great Wall, the CCTV Tower, Mangshan Forest Park, Lianhuashan Ski Resort and many more. A single Beijing Wildlife Park ticket normally costs more than the whole pass.

item.title: Qiandaohu 4-Night Lakeside Stay ¥698 (≈$98) — Daily Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Included
item.description:
Deal price: mountain-view room, 4 nights with 3 meals/day — ¥698 (≈$98) · 3 nights ¥598 (≈$85) · 2 nights ¥498 (≈$70) · 1 night ¥249 (≈$35) (63% of list) · Valid Sep 1, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · usable any day of the week, no weekend surcharge

A slow-travel deal on Qiandaohu (Thousand-Island Lake) in Chun’an: the Lichen Ruixuan sits in the central lake resort area, a short walk from the night-cruise pier and the fish-street food quarter. Every package includes daily breakfast, lunch and dinner for two, free parking, the gym, laundry room, kids’ playground and a games room.

item.title: Conghua Tianrenshanshui Camp Resort, Guangzhou — Tent/RV/Cabin Stay + Meals + Art Park & Lake Cruise ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night camp stay + meals + park tickets — ¥499 (≈$70) (was ¥699, ~29% off) · Valid Oct 13, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027, usable daily · Refundable anytime

A proper outdoorsy family escape in Guangzhou’s Conghua hills: the Tianrenshanshui Valley Camp （天人山水度假区·溪谷营地） Double-11 promo packs one night in your choice of sailing tent, safari tent, Chinese-style RV (bunk beds) or wooden cabin, plus breakfast and a proper dinner for two (fish-head hotpot with Xufu braised rice at 清集市）, Earth Art Park tickets for 2 adults + 1 kid, a Shaxi reservoir sightseeing cruise and the shuttle bunny cart. Mornings come with free mindfulness exercise (yoga / baduanjin), middays with a free sound-bowl meditation session, and weekends and holidays add a nature-study activity (3 options, for 2 adults + 1 kid).

item.title: Foshan Marriott Zhen Chu — Dinner Buffet from ¥279 (≈$39) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid (Wed/Thu/Sun)
item.description:
Deal price: dinner for 1 adult + 1 kid — ¥279 (≈$39) (was ¥318) · 2 adults + 2 kids — ¥529 (≈$75) · Valid Jan 15, 2026 – Jan 15, 2027 · usable Wednesdays, Thursdays and Sundays only, 18:00–21:00

A Marriott-grade family dinner by Qiandeng Lake in Foshan’s Nanhai district — right on the Guangzhou–Foshan metro line. The Zhen Chu Western Restaurant （臻厨西餐厅， 5F, 丽致汇广场， 38 Haiba East Road) serves around 100 land-and-sea dishes at its dinner buffet, at roughly 12% off the door price — and the value jumps on the 2-adult-2-kid bundle.

item.title: Foshan Metoo Sports Theme Park — 10,000㎡ Sci-Fi Play Arena: 1 Adult + 1 Kid 3-Hour Pass ¥188 (≈$26)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid, 3 hours of play — ¥188 (≈$26) · All-day solo ticket from ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥198) · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime

A rainy-day (or scorching-day) lifesaver for families in the Greater Bay Area: METOO HOME PATRY （万民店） is a 10,000㎡ sci-fi-themed sports arena across two floors, with 11 themed zones and 60+ immersive activities — trampolines, slides, ball pits, climbing and high-energy interactive games — pitched at everyone from age 3 to 50. The 3-hour parent–kid pass even allows multiple re-entries on the day of visit.

item.title: Guangzhou Santori Hot Spring Manor — 'Little Greece' Waterfront Resort: Hot-Spring Room with Private Terrace Pool + Meals ¥598 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + meals + pools — ¥598 (≈$84) (was ¥1,200, 50% off) · Buy-and-use, refundable if unreserved · Autumn promo, currently on sale

Nicknamed “Guangzhou’s Little Greece,” the Santori Hot Spring Manor （圣托利温泉庄园， 112 Wenquan East Road, Conghua) is a romantic waterfront resort built around a rare natural soda hot spring （珍稀苏打原汤真温泉）. The autumn promo bundles a lot into one price: a hot-spring room with its own private terrace soaking pool, buffet breakfast and dinner for two, plus the infinity pool and a kids’ splash pool.

item.title: Xiamen Science Museum — Multi-Hall Tickets from ¥80 (≈$11): Main Hall + Sea Monster + Kids' Zone + Cinema
item.description:
Deal price: multi-hall tickets from ¥80 (≈$11) · 4-hall adult ticket ¥139 (≈$20) / discounted ¥119 (≈$17) · Valid Oct 13 – Nov 30, 2026 · Tuesday–Sunday only · Buy-and-use, refundable anytime, auto-refund on expiry

The Xiamen Science Museum （厦门科技馆， 95 Tiyu Road, Siming — inside the Xiamen Culture & Arts Center) is a classic family day out, and these combo tickets bundle its headline halls at a discount. The 4-hall ticket covers the main exhibition hall, the Sea Monster exhibition, the kids’ zone and the flying cinema; the current Mars exhibition is the star draw. One combo even includes the Chengyi Nature Exploration Museum halls for a full multi-museum day.

item.title: Hui'an Longgu Shanfang Hot Spring Suite — ¥488 (≈$69) for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, was ¥988
item.description:
Deal price: hot-spring suite, 1 night — ¥488 (≈$69) (was ¥988, 50% off) · Bookable Sep 23 – Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026 · no surcharge on weekends

Longgu Shanfang （惠安龙谷山房， south of Longgu Shanfang, Hui’an County, Quanzhou) is a forest hot-spring retreat that bundles everything a family day needs into one voucher: soak, play and eat without leaving the property.

item.title: Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Family Lunch — ¥119 (≈$17) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid, was ¥198
item.description:
Deal price: weekday lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 6 — ¥119 (≈$17) (was ¥198, 50% off) · Bookable Oct 10, 2026 – Feb 27, 2027 · ⏰ valid through Feb 27, 2027

Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay （厦门五缘湾凯悦酒店， near the Bayview City mall, Huli, Xiamen) runs a Double-11 early-bird deal on its buffet lunch: seafood hot dishes, teppanyaki grills, sweet sashimi and more — eat as much as you like. 500+ vouchers already sold.

item.title: Xiamen Sujia Puyue Private Hot-Spring Villa — 3BR from ¥588 (≈$83), was ¥1,588
item.description:
Deal price: private hot-spring 3BR villa — from ¥588 (≈$83) (was ¥1,588, 38% off) · Bookable Sep 3 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Sujia Puyue （宿家·璞悦温泉民宿， 2-4 Xinzhen Road, Xiang’an, Xiamen) is a hot-spring villa stay built for group getaways: each standalone villa sleeps a whole family (or several) with its own private hot-spring pool, plus entertainment rooms downstairs. Every package includes free Wi-Fi, free parking and a hanfu dress-up experience.

item.title: Xiamen Tianyuan Hotel Seaview Buffet — ¥168 (≈$24) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid, was ¥298
item.description:
Deal price: lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.2 m — ¥168 (≈$24) (was ¥298, 27% off) · Bookable Jan 15 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026 · no surcharge on weekends

Xiamen Tianyuan Hotel （厦门天元酒店， 1813 Huandao East Road, Siming — the Huandao Road Convention Center branch, 1F Taste all-day restaurant) serves a seaview buffet with seafood, salmon, pan-seared foie gras and steak, plus a mini hot-pot station for cooler days. Every adult may bring 1 kid under 1.2 m free. 400+ vouchers already sold.

item.title: Zhangzhou Baixiang Yuanshan Hot Spring Hotel — Family Room from ¥799 (≈$113), was ¥1,999
item.description:
Deal price: family/kids room, 1 night — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,999, 40% off) · Bookable Jan 8 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Baixiang Yuanshan Hotel （漳州佰翔圆山酒店， 1 Daqiao Road, Xiangcheng, Zhangzhou) — voted a 2025 Fujian Top-20 family resort hotel — pairs big 65㎡+ family rooms with a 30,000㎡ ancient-seawater hot-spring complex, so you can soak, eat and explore the old town in one trip.

item.title: Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring — 1 Adult + 1 Child Ticket from ¥189 (≈$27), Any Day
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child hot-spring ticket — ¥189 (≈$27) (was ¥399, 48% off) · Bookable Jun 23 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Hidden in a forested valley in Changtai （长泰半月山温泉）, about an hour’s drive from Xiamen, Banyue Mountain is a strontium-rich soda spring （富锶苏打汤泉） done in wild-luxury style — soaking pools tucked into mountain woodland rather than concrete blocks. One ticket covers 1 adult plus 1 child, usable weekdays and weekends (open 13:00–23:00).

item.title: Jiaxing Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — 1-Night Terrace Room from ¥818 (≈$115) with Water Park & Kids' Club
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night Terrace Room — from ¥818 (≈$115) (was ¥1,398, 59% off) · Bookable Aug 21 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Kaiyuan Senbo Resort （开元森泊度假乐园， 1677 Ganpu Avenue, Haiyan, Jiaxing) is a national Top-100 family resort hotel built around water and play: a 31,000㎡ indoor-outdoor water park (the indoor part open year-round) plus Fantasy Island （幻想岛）, a 2,300㎡ indoor children’s playground. Every package includes breakfast for 2 at the Cave Restaurant （岩洞餐厅）, 2 park tickets of your choice (two parks to choose from), a handicraft workshop (pick 1 of 3), a 屹奇 travel photo shoot, welcome fruit, and day-1 minibar drinks.

item.title: Taihu Longemont Resort — 1-Night Stay from ¥629 (≈$89) at Your Choice of 3 Themed Hotels + 2 Park Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 park tickets — from ¥629 (≈$89) (was ¥1,298, 49% off) · Bookable Sep 14 – Dec 31, 2026, any day · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

One of China’s largest family resorts, Taihu Longemont （太湖龙之梦， Taihu resort area, Changxing, Huzhou) lets you choose your hotel — 动物世界大酒店 (Animal World Hotel), 钻石酒店 (Diamond Hotel), or 古镇大酒店 (Ancient Town Hotel) — and pick 2 park tickets from three options: the Animal World walk-through zone, the Ice & Snow Town, or the Performance City （演艺城）. A national Top-100 family resort hotel.

item.title: Xiamen InterContinental Seaview Hotel — Weekend 1 Adult + 1 Child Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m) — lunch ¥158 (≈$22) / dinner ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥262, 61% off) · Bookable Sep 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A Huandao Road landmark, the InterContinental Xiamen （厦门海景洲际酒店） is running a new seafood-season menu （开海季） across its 9 food stations and 100+ dishes. The deal covers 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m) with free access to the kids’ playground, and 3 hours of free parking. Lunch runs 11:30–14:00; dinner 17:30–21:30.

item.title: Anji Hello Kitty Castle Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Theme Park Entry, from ¥699 (≈$98)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 Hello Kitty Park adult tickets with 2-day unlimited entry — ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥1,098) · Currently bookable and reservable (the merchant page shows no end date — book while it’s live)

The Anji Yinjun Jinjiang Castle Hotel （安吉银润锦江城堡酒店， 8 Tiandao, Anji, Huzhou) is every kid’s fantasy base camp: a literal castle with a covered walkway straight into Hello Kitty Park, and the headline package includes adult tickets with unlimited re-entry across 2 days — arrive Friday afternoon, play Friday and Saturday, and never queue twice.

item.title: Guangzhou Latin Restaurant — Brazilian BBQ Buffet from ¥106 (≈$15), Weekdays
item.description:
Deal price: weekday all-you-can-eat Brazilian BBQ — from ¥106 (≈$15)/person (was ¥138) · Bookable Sep 10 – Oct 31, 2026, weekdays only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A Guangzhou institution for over a decade: the Latin Restaurant （拉丁餐厅） at Grandview Plaza （正佳广场， 4F, 228 Tianhe Road, near the Sports Center) serves an immersive Brazilian-style churrasco — 30+ kinds of grilled meats carved right at your table, plus 100+ buffet items, samba dancers, and guests are even invited on stage during the show. Kids get pasta and a chocolate fountain of their own.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Resort Hotel — 2 Nights + Scenic Tickets, Bamboo Raft & Night Show, from ¥839 (≈$118)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + 2-person scenic combo for ¥839 (≈$118) (was ¥1,199) · Bookable Sep 16 – Dec 31, 2026, no weekend surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qiyun Mountain （齐云山， Xiuning County, Huangshan) is in peak autumn sea-of-clouds season, and the resort hotel is running its “shaiqiu” (晒秋） harvest-season promo: no surcharge on weekends, plus a free room upgrade on non-holiday stays (mention it when booking).

item.title: Yangzhou Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel — 2 Nights + 3 Buffet Meals a Day, from ¥579 (≈$82)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + daily buffet breakfast, lunch & dinner for two — ¥579 (≈$82) (was ¥399/night) · Bookable Oct 10 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

This is the “livestream special” we’ve been waiting for in Yangzhou: the Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel （瘦西湖汇璟酒店） sits at the foot of Daming Temple right next to the 5A-rated Slender West Lake scenic area. Two nights in an elegant comfort room (28㎡, king or twin) with three buffet meals a day — breakfast, lunch and dinner — plus a free ride between the hotel and Yangzhou / Yangzhou East train station or the scenic area itself.

item.title: Zhangzhou Jiulongshuizhen — Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Grand Opening, from ¥89 (≈$13)
item.description:
Deal price: kid’s hot-spring ticket + hot-spring egg + perilla drink — ¥89 (≈$13) (was ¥199, 4.5折） · Bookable Sep 24 – Dec 30, 2026, weekdays · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

A brand-new hot-spring opening near Xiamen: the Jiulongshuizhen Resort’s Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Center （漳州九龙水镇度假区， 666 Taikouzhai, Hua’an County — about 40 minutes from Xiamen North station) leans into Song-dynasty aesthetics — ancient-style pools, fish therapy, herbal foot soaks, costume dress-up for photos, and a “Song-style Fujian meal” （宋风闽味） on the higher tiers.

item.title: Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Weekday Buffet — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥168 (≈$24)
item.description:
Deal price: weekday lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 6 — ¥168 (≈$24) (was ¥228, ~26% off) · Bookable Jan 21 – Dec 31, 2026, weekdays only · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The Hyatt Regency at Wuyuan Bay (湖里区钟宅西三路与枋湖路交叉路口, near Wanyuecheng business district) keeps its weekday lunch buffet at a fixed ¥168 for 1 adult + 1 child under 6 — over 1,000 vouchers sold, so this one is well battle-tested. Expect seafood hot dishes, teppan grills, fresh sashimi and 100+ dishes, plus juices, tea, coffee and a full salad bar.

item.title: Xiamen 'Southeast Asia Food Festival' Weekend Buffet, from ¥108 (≈$15) — Free Hairy Crab
item.description:
Deal price: single buffet lunch ¥108 (≈$15), dinner ¥118 (≈$17) (was ¥198, 5.5折) · Bookable Oct 9 – Dec 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The “bringing the flavors of Southeast Asia to Xiamen’s table” festival buffet (湖里区长浩路18号) leans into tropical comfort food — think satay grills, laksa and coconut desserts — and every dining adult is handed one free hairy crab during the festival. That’s a crab bonus on top of a buffet that already runs at about half price.

item.title: Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Park Tickets for 2, from ¥999 (≈$141)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 — from ¥999 (≈$141) (was ¥1,399, ~29% off) · Bookable Sep 16 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A turnkey theme-park weekend for two: the Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel (同安区石浔南路1111号), a newly opened family hotel ranked among Fujian’s top 20 family resorts, bundles a 1-night stay with breakfast and unlimited 2-day entry for 2 to Dream Kingdom (梦幻王国) or Oriental Heritage (东方神画) — Xiamen’s answer to the Disney two-day playbook, minus the flight.

item.title: Xiamen Thai Food Festival Buffet at Garden Hotel — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥118 (≈$17)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.3 m lunch — ¥118 (≈$17) (was ¥298, 2.7折) · Bookable Jul 22 – Oct 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

This is the deepest discount in today’s batch. An established garden-style hotel on 虎园路 in central Xiamen is running a Thai food-festival theme buffet — seafood, snacks, and teppan-grilled skewers coming off the iron in rotation — and the headline price works out to under 40% of the original ¥298. Kids between 1.3 m and 1.4 m have their own ¥78 tier. Over 600 vouchers have been sold.

item.title: Xiamen Weekend Buffet — Coca-Cola Pop-Up Edition, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.4 m, lunch or dinner — ¥158 (≈$22) (was ¥298, 5.4折) · Bookable Aug 29 – Oct 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A fun one for families: this Xiamen weekend buffet (湖里区南山冠军路6-13号) has teamed up with Coca-Cola for a pop-up edition — Coca-Cola–themed dishes, kiln-roasted pizza from a live oven, and unlimited limited-edition Coca-Cola mocktails. Dinner unlocks the bigger guns: crayfish and herb-grilled lamb chops from the teppan station.

item.title: Wuyuan Mingyu Hotel — 1 Night by a 4A Scenic Area + Breakfast from ¥299 (≈$42)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a Huizhou-style courtyard hotel + breakfast, from ¥299 (≈$42) (was ¥699, about 43% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026, weekends included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A first for this site: Jiangxi’s Wuyuan — the “most beautiful countryside in China” county, famous for its rapeseed fields and white-walled Huizhou villages. Mingyu Hotel sits right inside the Wangkou 4A scenic area, wrapped by two rivers, built as a Huizhou-style courtyard with the classic “thousand-gold gatehouse, four-tael house” (千金门楼、四两屋) layout. The hotel even has its own Hui-carving art museum by master Yu Youhong, with an interactive experience zone and evening guided tours (8:00 pm).
